title: Wonder Trade Guide - Shiny Odds, Hidden Abilities & Mechanics
description: Complete Wonder Trade guide for Polished Crystal. Trade any Pokémon for a random one at the same level in Goldenrod. 4x shiny rate (1/1024), 33% Hidden Ability chance, held items possible, 50/50 gender ratio. Offline Wonder Trade system explained with full mechanics and optimal strategies.
html:
Introduction

Polished Crystal has its own version of Wonder Trade that works offline - basically emulating the Gen VI–VII online feature without needing any connectivity. You trade a Pokémon and get a random one back at the same level, with boosted chances of it being Shiny, having a Hidden Ability, or holding an item.

It's a fun way to mix up your team or hunt for specific things you might not want to breed for or completing your dex.

How It Works

Source: wonder_trade.asm — engine/events/wonder_trade.asm, valid_level.asm — data/pokemon/valid_levels.asm, variant_forms.asm — data/pokemon/variant_forms.asm

  1. Head to the machine behind the clerk in the center of Goldenrod PCC
  2. Trade in any Pokémon
  3. The game checks its level and instantly returns a random Pokémon at that same level

That's it!

What Makes It Special

Here's where Wonder Trade gets interesting:

  • Shininess: 4× the normal shiny rate (1/1024 instead of 1/4096)
  • Abilities: Equal 1/3 chance of Ability #1, Ability #2, or Hidden Ability
  • Held items: Chance scales with level, plus a small chance for rare items (works similar to Pickup)
  • Gender: 50/50 male or female regardless of the species' normal gender ratio
  • OT: Randomly selected from internal name lists

The Hidden Ability thing is huge - normally those are a pain to get, but Wonder Trade gives you a 33% chance!

Egg Trading

Unlike the main series games, you can trade an Egg and get a random Egg back. Neat if you want to hatch something unexpected.

What You Can't Get

Wonder Trade won't give you:

  • Legendaries or other static encounter Pokémon
  • Unown
  • Eggs (unless you traded an Egg in)
